title: Add settings and environment compatibility layer
objective: Expose the original prompt-affecting settings and environment gates needed for behavioral parity.
context: The original lets settings and environment variables disable CLAUDE.md loading, skip auto-discovery in bare mode, exclude memory files, and include additional directories.
Go currently hardcodes much of this behavior or lacks the switches entirely.
This task adds the compatibility layer, not a full settings UI.
deliverables: Add bare-mode semantics for memory auto-discovery where applicable.
Add an additional-directories memory loading gate.
Expose language and output-style inputs for prompt sections if corresponding runtime settings exist.
acceptance: Settings and env gates have table-driven tests.
Default behavior remains compatible with existing DeepSeek Code behavior unless parity requires a documented change.
Unsupported settings fail closed or no-op with clear documentation.
Memory discovery from task_04 respects the new gates.
non_goals: Do not implement a settings UI.
Do not implement remote config or GrowthBook.
Do not change provider selection behavior.
handoff_notes: If a config package does not exist or is not suitable, keep the compatibility functions local to prompt/settings.go and document the limitation.
